exceptions.reason: The showcase renderer currently receives drawing resources individually.
exceptions.risk: The shallow signature makes resource ownership harder to evolve.
exceptions.compensation: The function is isolated to the showcase renderer and strict Clippy remains enabled elsewhere.
exceptions.removal_plan: Group role-specific drawing resources into an owned render context after the baseline is green.

exceptions.reason: RuntimeSurfaces currently coordinates five native windows during event dispatch.
exceptions.risk: Runtime ownership and mutation remain concentrated in one shallow call.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and runtime behavior remains covered by the deterministic platform suite.
exceptions.removal_plan: Introduce one runtime-session window context with explicit ownership after baseline stabilization.

exceptions.reason: Preview effects currently coordinate all native shell surfaces.
exceptions.risk: Preview changes can couple unrelated surface ownership.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and preview transitions retain focused tests.
exceptions.removal_plan: Move preview effect application behind a preview runtime Module with a narrow surface context.

exceptions.reason: Topbar actions currently dismiss or reposition multiple native overlays.
exceptions.risk: Overlay lifecycle knowledge is repeated across action handlers.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and existing topbar/controller tests remain required.
exceptions.removal_plan: Create one overlay surface context shared by topbar, popover and settings action application.

exceptions.reason: Opening the context menu currently coordinates every transient shell window.
exceptions.risk: Context-menu changes can affect unrelated surfaces through positional arguments.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and context-menu interaction tests remain required.
exceptions.removal_plan: Use the shared overlay surface context and keep context-menu state in its owning Module.

exceptions.reason: Context-menu effects currently receive all native surfaces individually.
exceptions.risk: The signature exposes orchestration details to an action-specific method.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and deterministic context-menu tests remain required.
exceptions.removal_plan: Apply typed overlay effects through the shared overlay surface context.

exceptions.reason: Popover effects currently receive all native surfaces individually.
exceptions.risk: The signature duplicates overlay lifecycle knowledge and broadens change impact.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and popover controller tests remain required.
exceptions.removal_plan: Apply typed popover effects through the shared overlay surface context.

exceptions.reason: Quick Settings actions currently coordinate the topbar and every transient native overlay.
exceptions.risk: The action handler duplicates overlay lifecycle knowledge and broadens the impact of panel changes.
exceptions.compensation: The allow is function-scoped and the platform and current-panel regression suites remain required.
exceptions.removal_plan: Apply typed Quick Settings effects through the shared overlay surface context.
